field_edits.updated_text: Marginal osteophytes are noted. No acute fracture or focal osseous lesion.
Reduction in the medial tibiofemoral and patellofemoral joint spaces is seen. No dislocation. The remaining joint spaces are normal.

impression: Degenerative changes with marginal osteophytes and reduced medial tibiofemoral and patellofemoral joint spaces.
